title: Mossy Forests
description: This Mod adds Mossy Forests to minecraft!
body:
# Mossy Forest

Transform your Minecraft world with the enchanting **Mossy Forest** biome! This mod brings a lush, mystical woodland experience filled with unique features and wildlife.

## Features

### 🌲 New Biome: Mossy Forest
Discover the atmospheric Mossy Forest biome, a dense woodland covered in moss and mystery. This biome features its own unique trees and vegetation, creating a distinct and immersive environment.
- **New Wood Type** - Pine wood which includes all wooden item recipies and wooden blocks

### 🪨 Natural Structures
- **Rock Piles** - Scattered throughout the forest, adding natural terrain variation and atmosphere

### 🐦 Wildlife
- **Birds** - Bring life to the canopy with ambient bird mobs
- **Squirrels** - Watch these critters scurry through the forest floor and trees

All new mobs spawn naturally within the Mossy Forest biome, making it feel truly alive!

## Coming Soon
- 
- More features and content updates!

## Perfect For
- Players looking for new exploration content
- Builders seeking unique biomes and materials
- Anyone who wants more life and atmosphere in their world

---

*Explore the moss-covered depths and discover what awaits in the Mossy Forest!*
